feature.name: amap-spec
feature.summary: Mounts this repository's rendered Internet-Draft (dist/), schemas, fixtures and spec/ read-only and LIVE into every amap-* sandbox, and tells the agent to conform to them. Since 2026-09-24 the draft is the normative prose; spec/contract.md is frozen history.
feature.install: This file lives at the ROOT of the amap-spec checkout. ./install-sandy-feature.sh symlinks $SANDY_HOME/features/amap-spec at this directory, which makes the checkout itself the feature directory -- that is what lets the mounts be live rather than copies.
feature.note: The `feature` key is reserved and never interpreted by sandy. It is the ONLY place free prose may go: a selection block accepts `include` and `exclude` and nothing else, and an unknown key refuses the whole manifest -- which fails every launch on the host, not just this feature.
feature.exclude_note: sandboxes patterns are matched against the SLUG (amap-spec-<sha8>) and the workspace HOST PATH, anchored at both ends. A bare 'amap-spec' matches neither and is a silent no-op -- nothing warns that a pattern matched zero sandboxes. Two anchors are kept because each covers a naming accident the other does not. Deliberately NOT 'amap-spec-*', which would also swallow a future amap-spec-tools.
